target.role: approximate externally published natural hydrothermal/tectonic region coordinate selected before this temporal calibration

support_matched_secondary_if_2005_suppor.reference: one CD169 2005 sounding per occupied 100m geometry-cell, nearest cell center; depth not used for selection
support_matched_secondary_if_2005_suppor.interpretation: secondary sensitivity only; does not overwrite strict result

diagnostic_logic.if_strict_or_support_matched_passes: 2005 EM12 pipeline demonstrates at least some temporal sensitivity on an externally known natural region; CAND003 temporal FAIL becomes more candidate-specific.
diagnostic_logic.if_both_fail: 2005 EM12 cannot pass the same temporal morphology gate even on the external known-positive region; treat CAND003 temporal FAIL primarily as a data-resolution/processing comparability limit, not evidence that morphology changed.
